PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.label: Custom OpenAI-compatible
PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions. Temperature and optional OpenAI reasoning controls are available; the model stays editable for proxies.

PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.label: OpenAI Responses
PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.description: OpenAI Responses API. Temperature and optional OpenAI reasoning controls are available; the model stays editable.

PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.label: Anthropic
PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.description: Anthropic Messages. Pawn Diary omits the global temperature and generic OpenAI reasoning controls for this protocol.

PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.label: Gemini Developer API (API key)
PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.description: Gemini generateContent. Temperature is sent only after model discovery reports a supported maximum; generic OpenAI reasoning is hidden and Gemini thinking is managed automatically.

PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.label: Ollama native
PawnDiary.DiaryApiProviderPresetDef.description: Ollama native chat. Temperature and the configured output-token cap are sent; generic OpenAI reasoning is hidden and native thinking is managed automatically.
